_note: GAIN 2026 form 'Global Annual Inclusion Survey 2026' on UNHCR Kobo. Question names are the 'name' column of the XLSForm. The API token is never stored here: it comes from the KOBO_TOKEN secret. Nothing in the FOC section (focal points: names, positions, emails) is ever read.

review_form._note: The decisions form of the standalone review page (dashboard/review/), made by dashboard/tools/review_form.py from alignment/spec/review_form.json. Reviewers submit to it without an account; the publish workflow reads it with KOBO_TOKEN.
